Vocabulary Booster.question:
১) Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word.
Don't condone such acts which lead to unrest in the country.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Condone (verb transitive)
English Meaning: To ignore or accept behavior that some people consider wrong.
Bangla Meaning: (১) (অপরাধ) ক্ষমা করা; না দেখার ভান করা।
(২) ক্ষতিপূরণ করা; পুষিয়ে যাওয়া: His honesty condones his many short comings.
Synonyms: Disregard (অগ্রাহ্য করা), Forgive (মার্জনা করা), Pardon (ক্ষমা করা),  Overlook(উপেক্ষা করা).
Antonyms: Condemn (দোষ দেওয়া), Punish (শাস্তি বা দণ্ড দেওয়া).
Other Forms: Condonation (noun) ক্ষমা; মার্জনা।
Example Sentence: ‘If the government is seen to condone violence, the bloodshed will never stop.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ২) Strut, stride and swagger are words that describe a manner of -
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Strut (verb intransitive)
English Meaning: To walk with your chest pushed forward and your shoulders back to show you are proud.
Bangla Meaning: (strutted, strutting, struts) সদর্পে পদচারণ করা।
Synonyms: Swagger (সদম্ভে চলাফেরা), Parade (কুচকাওয়াজ করা), Stride (লম্বা লম্বা পা ফেলে চলা).
Antonyms: Conceal (গোপন করা), Mask (মুখোশ), Disguise (ছদ্মবেশ ধারণ করা).
Other Forms: - (noun) সদর্প পদচারণা।
- [countable noun] কাঠামোর শক্তিবৃদ্ধির জন্য ভিতরে প্রবিষ্ট কাঠ বা ধাতুর টুকরা; গোঁজ।
Example Sentence: ‘The boys strutted around like peacocks, showing off to some girls nearby.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
৩) In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.
Delay or prevent someone or something by obstructing them.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Impede (verb transitive)
English Meaning: To slow something down or prevent an activity from making progress at its previous rate.
Bangla Meaning: ব্যাহত/বাধিত/বাধাগ্রস্থ করা; বাধা দেওয়া।
Synonyms: Delay (বিলম্ব/দেরি করা), Obstruct (বাধা দেওয়া), Retard (দমন করা).
Antonyms: Facilitate (সহজ করা).
Other Forms: Impeder (noun).
Example Sentence: ‘As I tried to enter the concourse, a slow person was impeding my progress.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৪) The criminal was _____ on the basis of him being politically affiliated.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Exculpate (verb transitive)
English Meaning: Show or declare that (someone) is not guilty of wrongdoing.
Bangla Meaning: (from) অভিযোগাদি থেকে নিষ্কৃতি দেওয়া।
Synonyms: Release (মুক্তি/অব্যাহতি দেওয়া), Liberate (মুক্ত করা), Free (ছেড়ে দেওয়া).
Antonyms: Criminate (অভিযুক্ত করা), Incriminate (দোষী/দোষারোপ করা).
Other Forms: Exculpation (noun).
Example Sentence: ‘The mother in her evidence tried hard to exculpate the father from any responsibility.’

According to the explanation and examples that are given above, 'Exculpated' is the appropriate word to fill in the blank.
Complete Sentence: The criminal was exculpated on the basis of him being politically affiliated.
অর্থ: রাজনৈতিকভাবে জড়িত থাকার ভিত্তিতে অপরাধীকে অভিযোগ থেকে নিষ্কৃতি দেওয়া হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
৫) Select the meaning of the given idiom.
Chip off the old block
Vocabulary Booster.option1: ক) Having interest in antique furniture
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Chip of the old block (Idiom)
English Meaning: someone who resembles their parents in character or appearance.
Bangla Meaning: পিতা বা মাতার মত হওয়া / বাপকা বেটা
Ex. Sentence: He was a chip of the old block.
Bangla Meaning: সে একদম বাপের মতই হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
৬) Fill in the blank with an appropriate word:
The ruler was _____ all of his powers.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Divest (verb transitive)
English Meaning: To get rid of an investment, part of a business, etc. by selling.
Bangla Meaning:
divest somebody of (১) (আনুষ্ঠানিক) পোশাক খুলে নেওয়া: The priest was divested of his robes.
(২) ক্ষমতা কেড়ে নেওয়া; The ruler was divested all of his powers.
(৩) পরিহার করা; পরিত্যাগ করা: He could not divest himself of the idea of marriage.
Synonyms: Deprive (বঞ্চিত/বিরহিত করা), Unburden (ভারমুক্ত করা), Relieve (স্বস্তি দেওয়া).
Antonyms: Burden (ভার; বোঝা), Encumber (পথরোধ করা), Saddle (গুরুদায়িত্ব অর্পণ করা; বোঝা চাপানো).
Other Forms: Divestment (noun).
Example Sentence: ‘She has divested herself of (= sold) some of her share-holdings.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
৭) Choose the appropriate meaning of the idioms from the choice given:
A cock and bull story
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Cock and bull story
English Meaning: an implausible story used as an explanation or excuse.
Bangla Meaning: আষাঢ়ে গল্প / আজগুবি গল্প
Ex. Sentence: Nobody believes this cock and bull story about the sacking incident
Bangla Meaning: কেউই বরখাস্তের ঘটনা নিয়ে আষাঢ়ে গল্প বিশ্বাস করে না

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ৮) The word “ASCETIC” means -
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Ascetic (adjective)
English Meaning: Avoiding physical comforts and living a simple life.
Bangla Meaning: কৃচ্ছ্রব্রতী; আত্মনিরোধী; কঠোর; কঠোর তপশ্চর্যাপূর্ণ।
Synonyms: Austere (নিরাভরণ; কঠোর), Rigorous (কঠোর; প্রচণ্ড), Strict (শক্ত; কড়া আনুগত্য), Hermit (নির্জনবাসী ব্যক্তি; তপস্বী)।.
Antonyms: Sybaritic (বিলাসী).
Other Forms:
- Ascetic (noun): Hermit (তপস্বী); তাপস; Recluse(সন্ন্যাসী); কৃচ্ছ্রব্রতী।
- Ascetically [আসেটিক্‌লি] (adverb): কঠোরভাবে; তপস্বীর মতো।
- Asceticism [আসেটিসিজাম্‌] (noun): কৃচ্ছ্রব্রত; কঠোর তপশ্চর্যা; বৈরাগ্য; সন্ন্যাস।
Example Sentence: ‘They live a very ascetic life.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
৯) Choose the word which best expresses the opposite meaning of the word.
ENGENDER
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Engender (verb transitive)
English Meaning: To cause something to come into existence.
Bangla Meaning: (কোনো পরিস্থিতির) কারণ উদ্ভূত হওয়া: crime is often engendered by poverty.
Synonyms: Generate (ঘটানো), create (সৃষ্টি করা), trigger (সূত্রপাত করা).
Antonyms: Cease (বিরত হওয়া, থামা), End (সমাপ্ত হওয়া), Stop (কোনোকিছু থামিয়ে দেওয়া), (Restrain)ধরে রাখা; নিয়ন্ত্রণে রাখা.
Other Forms: 
Example Sentence: ‘Her latest book has engendered a lot of controversy.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture, Bangla Academy Dictionary

Vocabulary Booster.question:
১০) Choose appropriate meaning of the idioms from the choices given.
The cold shoulder
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Cold shoulder
English Meaning: a show of intentional unfriendliness / an unfriendly attitude shown.
Bangla Meaning: অবন্ধুসুলভ আচরণ
Ex. Sentence: He showed a cold shoulder when danger came.
Bangla Meaning: সে বিপদের সময় মুখ ফিরিয়ে নিলো।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১১) A cat’s love is only cupboard love. It means -
Vocabulary Booster.option1: ক) A cat does not carry any love.
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ)  A cat’s love is only outward.
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) A cat loves its master secretly.
Vocabulary Booster.option4: ঘ) A cat has a genuine love for everybody.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Cupboard love
English Meaning: love is shown by someone, typically a child, in order to get something that they want, such as food.
Bangla Meaning: কিছু পাওয়ার জন্য স্নেহের ভান করা / টাকাপয়সা হাতানোর লোভে প্রেম
Ex. Sentence: I hope that it is not just cupboard love on the part of the regions.
Bangla Meaning: আশা করি এলাকার এই অংশে টাকা পয়সা হাতিয়ে নেওয়ার জন্য এমন যত্ন আত্তি করে না।

A cat does not seem to be capable of the personal devotion often shown by a dog.
It thinks most of its own comfort, and its love is only cupboard love.
Upon the perusal of the above line, it can be deduced that a cat never loves anyone i.e. it doesn't carry any love.
It just shows love to get the things wanted.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১২) Which one is a verb?
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Inchoate is an adjective; Shard is a noun. Plummet is a verb.
Plummet (verb intransitive)
English Meaning: To fall very quickly and suddenly.
Bangla Meaning: (plummeted, plummeting, plummets) দ্রুত পড়ে যাওয়া বা নেমে আসা: plummetting share prices.
Synonyms: Dive (দ্রুত উচ্চ স্তর থেকে নিচু স্তরে নেমে আসা), Plunge (ঝাঁপ দেওয়া), Crash (প্রচণ্ড শব্দে বিধ্বস্ত হওয়া).
Antonyms: Arise (আবির্ভূত হওয়া; ওঠা), Rise (ওঠা), Lift (তোলা; উত্তোলন করা; উঁচু করা).
Other Forms:
- Plummet [প্লামিট্] (noun) ওলন; ওলনদড়ি; ফাতনা সোজা রাখার জন্য ছিপের প্রান্তে বাঁধা ভার।
Example Sentence: ‘The parachute failed to open and he plummeted to the ground.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
১৩) Select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.
To give the devil his due.
Vocabulary Booster.option1: ক) To punish the wrong person.
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ) To give credit to even a notorious person.
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) To let the enemy learn the lesson on his own.
Vocabulary Booster.option4: ঘ) To stand in the way of the devil.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Give the devil his due is a proverb.
English Meaning: if someone or something generally considered bad or undeserving has any redeeming features these should be acknowledged.
Bangla Meaning: শয়তানকেও তার ন্যায্য পাওনা দিও।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
১৪) Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.
The final section of a long piece of music.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Coda (noun)
English Meaning: A piece of music at the end of a longer piece of music, usually separate from the basic structure.
Bangla Meaning: সংগীতের সমাপ্তি অংশ।
Synonyms: Addendum (অভিযোজ্য বস্তু), Ending (শব্দ অথবা কাহিনির সমাপ্তি), Finale (পরিসমাপ্তি).
Antonyms: Foreword (প্রারম্ভিক মন্তব্য), Introduction (ভূমিকা), Preface (মুখবন্ধ; প্রস্তাবনা).
Example Sentence: ‘The coda is often more technically difficult than the rest of the piece.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৫) Select the correctly spelt word.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Here, correctly spelling word is Insinuate.
Insinuate (verb transitive)
Synonyms: Imply (ইঙ্গিত করা), Hint (ইঙ্গিত/আভাস দেওয়া), Indicate (নির্দেশ করা).
Antonyms: Announce (ঘোষণা করা), Declare (ঘোষণা/বিজ্ঞাত করা), Proclaim (প্রকাশ/প্রকটিত করা).
English Meaning: To express but not directly state something.
Bangla Meaning: (১) insinuate something/oneself (into) ধীরে ধীরে সুকৌশলে প্রবেশ করা বা করানো; insinuate oneself into a person’s favour, ধীরে ধীরে সুচতুরভাবে কারো অনুগ্রহভাজন হওয়া।
(২) insinuate (to be) that বক্রোক্তি/কটাক্ষ করা; ঠেস দেওয়া: insinuate (to somebody) that someone lacks integrity of character.
Other Forms: Insinuation [ইন্‌সিনিউএইশ্‌ন্‌] (noun) [uncountable noun, countable noun] ধীরে ধীরে সুকৌশলে অভ্যন্তরপ্রবেশ; কটাক্ষপাত; বক্রোক্তি।
Example Sentence: ‘Musicians have the gift of melody, they can insinuate something into the culture.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৬) The proverb, “Grapes are sour” is related -
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Grapes are sour is a proverb.
“Grapes are sour” is the expression we use when someone puts something down in a negative way or makes it out to be unimportant solely because it is unattainable to them. Oftentimes the term is used to signify resentment.
Bangla Meaning: আঙুর ফল টক।
Rationalization is the action of attempting to explain or justify behaviour or an attitude with logical reasons, even if these are not appropriate.

The proverb "grapes are sour" (rationalizing something as bad because it could not be attained) is an example of rationalization of behavior.
Rationality on the other hand is based on reasons given objectively and is not colored by one's perceptions.
Thus, it is concluded that The proverb, “Grapes are sour” is related to Rationalization.

Vocabulary Booster.question:
১৭) Select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.
Equanimity
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Equanimity [Uncountable noun]
Synonyms: Calmness (শান্ততা, বিশ্রান্ততা), Serenity (প্রশান্তি), Equilibrium (ভারসাম্য).
Antonyms: Anxiety (ভয় ও অনিশ্চয়তাবোধ; উদ্বেগ; দুশ্চিন্তা).
English Meaning: The state of being calm and in control of your emotions, especially in a difficult situation.
Bangla Meaning: মনমেজাজের প্রশান্তি।
Other Forms: 
Example Sentence: ‘In spite of her financial troubles, she faced the future with equanimity.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question: ১৮) Select the odd word from the given options.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Fickle and variable both are synonymous with capricious. but consistent is the antonym of capricious.
Capricious (adjective)
English Meaning: Likely to change, or reacting to a sudden desire or new idea.
Bangla Meaning: খেয়ালি; চপল; লোলচিত্ত; অস্থিরমতি।
Synonyms: Fickle (দৃঢ়ভাবে অনুগত নয় এমন), Inconstant (অস্থিরচিত্ত), Variable (পরিবর্তনশীল).
Antonyms: Stable (সহজে পরিবর্তনীয় নয়), Consistent (সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ).
Other Forms: Capriciously (adjective) খেয়ালখুশিমতো; মর্জিমাফিক।
Example Sentence: ‘We have had very capricious weather lately.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Vocabulary Booster.question:
১৯) Select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase.
Cooks the Books
Vocabulary Booster.option1: ক) To falsify financial records for a company or organization.
Vocabulary Booster.option2: খ) To read the books all night to get success.
Vocabulary Booster.option3: গ) To not be as good as someone else.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Cooks the Books
English Meaning: alter facts or figures dishonestly or illegally.
Bangla Meaning: কারচুপি করা
Ex. Sentence: He was an accountant, he could have cooked the books and made himself a lot more money.
Bangla Meaning: সে একজন হিসেব রক্ষক ছিলো, চাইলেই সে কারচুপির মাধ্যমে অনেক টাকা আয় করতে পারতো।

Vocabulary Booster.question:
২০) Choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
One who pretends illness to escape duty.
Vocabulary Booster.exp:
Malingerer (noun)
English Meaning: A person who pretends to be ill in order to avoid having to work.
Bangla Meaning: যে ব্যক্তি কর্তব্য এড়াতে অসুস্থতার ভান করে।
Synonyms: Slacker (অলস ব্যক্তি; ফাঁকিবাজ), Idler (অলস), Layabout (অলস; অকর্মণ্য ব্যক্তি).
Antonyms: Hustler (কর্মতত্পর ব্যক্তি), Workaholic (অতিরিক্ত পরিশ্রমী), Hard worker (কঠোর পরিশ্রমী).
Other Forms: - Malinger [মালিঙ্গা(র্‌)] (verb intransitive) কর্তব্য এড়াতে অসুস্থতার ভান করা।
Example Sentence: ‘I'm pretty sure boss thinks I'm a malingerer.’

Source: Live MCQ Lecture
